title: Following an annotated multiplication
description: You can compare the declared types with the supplied call's actual result.

steps.description: multiply annotates both parameters and its result as int. You can see that the body only returns x * y.

steps.question: What will the supplied call produce from 'ha' and 3?
steps.answer: It produces hahaha because multiplying a string by an integer repeats the string.

steps.description: You store the returned string in result and print it. The supplied output contains hahaha.
type(result) prints the str class. You observe the actual runtime type alongside the function's int annotation.
